before_times: which round, party or portable course, and the date and time
how many players, and each one's age group (under 7, 7 to 17, or adult)
for a party: the expected number of guests
for a portable course: the kind of place (a yard, a school, a park) and the town
after_time: the birthday child's first name, if the booker wants it used
anything staff should know to help (answers about health stay on the secure page)
secure_page_only: a waiver for every player: an adult signs their own; a parent or legal guardian signs for each child
the waiver's health check: a heart condition, a recent surgery, or a back or neck problem (the answer stays on the secure page; kart drivers answer it too)
the party's guest list (first names only), and an emergency contact
for a portable course: the street address and a flat area about 40 by 60 feet
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult (18 or over) books for a group; a parent or guardian books for a child; a child under 7 plays only with a paying adult on the course

stop.words: someone hit by a kart, or a crash with someone hurt or bleeding, or someone choking or not breathing right now
stop.say: Call 911 now. Don't move someone with a head, neck or back injury.

stop.words: a child missing from the course or the party
stop.say: Call 911 now if the child can't be found at once. The host calls the parent and the manager.

go_on.words: a heart condition, a recent surgery, or a back or neck problem
go_on.what: the booking can go on for the others; the waiver says who shouldn't drive a kart; the person decides, and Rosie gives no health advice

steps: a waiver for every player, signed on the secure page before the visit and good for 12 months; a parent signs for each child
the party's final headcount 3 days before (it sets the rest due)
a portable course: the customer confirms the flat area, any outlet the crew needs, and any permission the place needs, 3 days before
first_steps_and_forms.prep: comfortable shoes; a jacket for an evening round; arrive 15 minutes early

staff.skills: course host, kart marshal, party host, portable course crew
staff.licenses_or_certificates: none from the state; first-aid and CPR cards for hosts and marshals, tracked by the venue
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs refunds, party changes and anything over $500
staff.stand_in: any trained host or crew member; nobody is booked by name
staff.ratio: one host per 6 players at a time, as the venue's safety plan sets; a portable course always has 2 crew

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult (18 or over) books for a group; a parent or guardian books for a child; a child under 7 plays only with a paying adult on the course
children_and_age.minors_texts: texts go to the parent who booked, never to a child

visit.check_in: at the front desk: the booker's code for the group; the desk sees which players have a waiver on file, and each one gets a scorecard and a ball and putter set; the host checks the party in
visit.done: the desk's check-in confirms the visit; the host texts DONE at the end of the party; the crew texts DONE after takedown
visit.changes_at_visit: extra players on the day are added at the per-player price if a course is free; the booker says yes first

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: where the state's rules require it: the business's registration, and a permit for the go-karts or the course where the state requires one; a portable course follows the same rules where they cover it
license.ask: the business registration, and any state permit for the karts or the course with its last inspection date; the liability insurance certificate
license.insurance: liability insurance for the course, the karts and events at a customer's place, as the state or the venue asks
license.background: background checks for hosts who work with children, where the venue or the rules require them

never_in_a_text: children's names, ages and health answers, and injury details: only on the secure page
